name: Upload / CSV Import
description: CSV Import product scenario for the Upload component.

props.label: Customer list
props.description: A CSV file up to 10 MB with a header row.
props.name: customers

controls.name: label
controls.description: Visible name of the value. Empty content leaves naming to aria-label/aria-labelledby.

controls.name: description
controls.description: Help for entering the value, announced with the focused control.

controls.name: error
controls.description: Validation message; marks the field invalid unless aria-invalid is explicit. Not a live region.

controls.name: labelPosition
controls.description: Label above the control, or at its inline start (stacks when narrow). Defaults to top.

controls.name: files
controls.description: Controlled list; an entry without a string `id`, or repeating an earlier one, is dropped.

controls.name: defaultFiles
controls.description: List on mount when `files` is not set, restored by form reset; read once.

controls.name: accept
controls.description: File types the picker offers and a drop accepts, as the native accept: `image/*`, `.pdf`, `text/csv`.

controls.name: multiple
controls.description: Lets the list hold several files; without it a new file replaces the listed one.

controls.name: maxSize
controls.description: Largest accepted file in bytes; omitted means no limit.

controls.name: maxFiles
controls.description: Most files the list holds with `multiple`; omitted means no limit.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Stops picking, dropping and removing, and leaves the files out of form submission.

controls.name: name
controls.description: FormData key under which the listed browser files are submitted.

controls.name: form
controls.description: Id of the form that submits and resets the files, when it is not an ancestor.

controls.name: required
controls.description: Blocks form submission while the list is empty and marks the label.

controls.name: autoFocus
controls.description: Focuses the button that opens the file picker on mount.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Names the group when there is no visible `label`.

controls.name: aria-labelledby
controls.description: Ids of the elements that name the group; they win over `label` and `aria-label`.

controls.name: labels
controls.description: Strings Upload renders itself: the drop instruction, the button names and the rejection messages.
